user_message: You said a detector click shows a photon took one path through the interferometer. But the detector was placed only at the output. What can we actually infer about the earlier path?
allowed_evidence: An output detection event records an outcome at that detector. Without a path-marking interaction, quantum theory generally assigns amplitudes to alternatives and does not license treating one unobserved path as a measured classical fact. Interpretations may describe the intermediate history differently while agreeing on observed probabilities.
public_rubric: Separates measured outcomes from inferred histories.
States what additional measurement would support a path claim and notes its effect on interference.
